purpose: Machine-readable topology assignments for the small set of operators that organize the Potato House. These annotations drive projection and navigation; they do not replace canonical concept owners or evidence classes.
rules: Concept placement is functional orientation, not literal physical location.
A concept may have several orientations and roles.
Room membership does not change canonical ownership.
Regime labels describe system behavior and are not identities of persons, populations or entire realms.
Geometry alone has no fixed moral valence.
The authoritative operator graph is relations[]; counter_or_complement is descriptive vocabulary only and may name terms outside the core operator registry.
Typed centers are role coordinates, not identity claims; person/archetype population is owned by the three-center role atlas.

concepts.label: Son / Manifestation / Body
concepts.operation: expresses embodiment, manifestation, Vessel, suffering, visible event, consequence, Seed-bearing potential and return inside the triune Potato of Life
concepts.boundary: Son is manifestation-facing and Door-related but not identical with O/Door or the entire Manifestation Field.

concepts.label: Father
concepts.operation: expresses source, origin, House, Root, orientation, holding, Gardener responsibility and source-facing identity inside the triune Potato of Life
concepts.boundary: Father is not identical with the entire Source Field and does not by itself exhaust the Potato of Life as a whole.

concepts.label: Potato of Life
concepts.operation: names the mature triune whole in which Father/source, Son/manifestation-passage and Spirit/living relation remain distinct without becoming separate theological systems
concepts.boundary: Potato of Life as triune whole is project theology. The ordinary potato/tuber remains a biological object and symbolic comparator; Tim/Father is source-facing within the whole rather than structurally exhausting the whole.

concepts.label: Source Field
concepts.operation: holds source-facing architecture, orientation, House/Garden and integrative reference without exhausting the whole Potato
concepts.boundary: Source-facing does not mean automatically true, good or empirically validated.

concepts.label: Manifestation Field
concepts.operation: holds embodiment, Earth/world, soil, work, history, institutions and observable consequence
concepts.boundary: Manifestation is not identical with Swamp, Strife, Saturn or Cube.

concepts.label: Door
concepts.operation: creates or governs passage where bounded contexts genuinely meet; changes admissible state/context
concepts.boundary: Not every hyperlink or resemblance is a strong Door.

formal_type.note: Project Door is not automatically a geometric, quantum or physical Door.

concepts.label: Plane
concepts.operation: selects a frame-relative world-facing section, exposes lateral relations, and provides a surface on which trajectory crossings/recurrences can be compared
concepts.boundary: Plane is a section/frame, not a realm, folder, inferior world, or universal physical present.

concepts.label: Axis
concepts.operation: provides source↔manifestation orientation and continuity through changing levels/descriptions
concepts.boundary: Axis is not asserted as a literal extra physical dimension.

formal_type.note: Project Axis is principally orientation/order unless another component is explicitly modeled.

concepts.label: Cross-point O
concepts.operation: marks O = Axis ∩ Plane, the point where vertical orientation and the active frame are simultaneously legible
concepts.boundary: Cross-point O is not the entire Cross sign, Door, or Plane; Christian Cross meanings remain tradition-specific.

concepts.label: Face
concepts.operation: makes a source/subject present to another and supports recognition/accountability
concepts.boundary: Face-language is theological/symbolic unless a separate empirical context is specified.

concepts.label: Eye
concepts.operation: receives/discerns signals and, in potato biology, names a latent generative bud/aperture
concepts.boundary: Symbolic Eye mappings do not make the pineal or other anatomy a supernatural organ.

formal_type.note: This is a measurement comparator, not a supernatural-anatomy claim.

concepts.label: Spirit / Breath / Flow
concepts.operation: models animation, movement, continuity and translation across relations
concepts.boundary: Spiritual flow and biological/physical flows remain separately typed.

formal_type.note: Biological, physical, social and theological flows retain separate domains and units.

concepts.label: Potato / Tuber
concepts.operation: stores embodied capacity and can release it into new growth through eyes/sprouts
concepts.boundary: Botanically a potato tuber is a modified stem, not a root.

concepts.label: Seed
concepts.operation: compresses transferable future possibility that may remain dormant, decay, root or sprout
concepts.boundary: Seed metaphors do not prove supernatural biological mechanisms.

concepts.label: Root
concepts.operation: anchors provenance, ancestry, cause, memory, nourishment and traction for later growth
concepts.boundary: Depth is not inferiority; root is not inherently negative.

concepts.label: Tree
concepts.operation: turns one/few sources into structured many branches, fruit and future seed
concepts.boundary: Tree and Mountain are complementary operations, not moral opposites.

concepts.label: Mountain
concepts.operation: compresses/integrates many paths or details toward a smaller summit/reference
concepts.boundary: Height is not automatically holiness or truth.

concepts.label: Ladder
concepts.operation: orders multiple meaningful Doors/thresholds into a traversable sequence
concepts.boundary: A Ladder is not a literal physical dimension by default.

concepts.label: Spiral
concepts.operation: represents recurrence with changed state/level rather than exact return
concepts.boundary: Spiral is a trajectory description, not a guarantee of improvement.

formal_type.note: Specific scientific spiral mechanisms require separate evidence.

concepts.label: Fruit
concepts.operation: expresses consequence/output whose quality tests whether upstream relations were actually generative
concepts.boundary: Output quality must be assessed in its domain; symbolic fruit is not evidence by itself.

concepts.label: Garden
concepts.operation: creates viable conditions for repair, autonomy, nourishment and future generativity
concepts.boundary: Garden is a functional regime, not a claim that one geography or group is intrinsically holy.

concepts.label: Shell / Cube
concepts.operation: models containment that becomes capture when circulation, exit, repair or autonomous differentiation are blocked
concepts.boundary: Cube geometry is not inherently evil; Saturn/666, Heaven-cube and city/sanctuary tracks remain distinct.

concepts.label: Swamp
concepts.operation: models unresolved entanglement, opacity, duplicated ownership, feedback without healthy exit and unprocessed accumulation
concepts.boundary: Swamp describes mechanisms/states, not peoples or literal terrain.

concepts.label: Twin Pillars
concepts.operation: models differentiated supports that stabilize or announce legitimate passage into a House/threshold
concepts.boundary: Jachin/Boaz and later pillar traditions are historical comparators; the project pair is not claimed to be their hidden original meaning.

concepts.label: C_F · Source Seat
concepts.operation: marks the upper/source-field center and upper Door tip used for source, holding, House, throne/seat and orientation functions
concepts.boundary: C_F is a role coordinate. Tim Dooley is the project-persona anchor in the separate three-center atlas; the coordinate is not proof that other source figures or divine names are identical with Tim.

concepts.label: C_S · Twin / Vessel / Seed Center
concepts.operation: marks the lower/manifestation-field center and lower Door tip used for embodiment, Vessel, Seed, witness, descent, rejection, testing and return functions
concepts.boundary: C_S is a role coordinate. Thomas/Didymus is its primary Twin/Vessel anchor in the separate three-center atlas; comparison does not make every descent, rejected-son or dying-returning figure the same person.

concepts.label: Here / Now · Operative Present
concepts.operation: gathers memory/provenance, current embodied state, relation and available futures into the present state from which crossing, choice, action and new Seed can occur
concepts.boundary: Project phenomenological/theological operator; not proof that chronological time is unreal or that all spacetime is literally co-present.

concepts.label: Mind · Integrative / Orienting Function
concepts.operation: integrates relations, memory and orientation on the Father/source-facing side
concepts.boundary: Mind is a project functional layer, not reducible to thalamus or one brain region.

concepts.label: Body · Manifestation / Consequence Function
concepts.operation: receives and expresses state through sensation, action, vulnerability, work, history and observable consequence
concepts.boundary: Body/manifestation is not morally lower and does not exhaust the Son role.

concepts.label: Lion · Strength / Royal Return Motif
concepts.operation: expresses strength, kingship, courage or return within selected Son-side and tradition-specific contexts
concepts.boundary: Lion is one bounded motif among several Son-side roles; biblical lion traditions retain their own contexts.

concepts.label: Cross Sign / Axis + Lateral
concepts.operation: renders the vertical Axis together with a chosen lateral line inside Plane through O
concepts.boundary: Coordinate Cross-sign is a project visual/formal object; it does not explain the historical origin or theology of the Christian cross.

concepts.label: Crossing Event
concepts.operation: records a trajectory intersecting the active Plane and, when Door guards are satisfied, changing state/context
concepts.boundary: Not every Plane crossing is a strong Door transition.

relation_types.label: overlaps with
relation_types.semantics: Two complete domains share a genuine region while remaining distinguishable.

relation_types.label: intersection of
relation_types.semantics: The source node is constituted by the shared region of the target domain(s).

relation_types.label: sections
relation_types.semantics: The source cuts or selects a section through the target without becoming its owner.

relation_types.label: passes through
relation_types.semantics: The source provides continuity/orientation through the target.

relation_types.label: derived from
relation_types.semantics: The source is generated by the relation of one or more target coordinates/operators.

relation_types.label: located within
relation_types.semantics: The source is an internal point/region/event of the target rather than a separate container.

relation_types.label: presents to
relation_types.semantics: A presentation surface becomes available to a receiving/perceiving interface.

relation_types.label: perceives
relation_types.semantics: A receiving interface takes in or discerns a presented signal/face.

relation_types.label: flows through
relation_types.semantics: A movement/continuity process traverses the target relation or orientation.

relation_types.label: contains generative site
relation_types.semantics: The source contains a local structure capable of initiating new growth.

relation_types.label: supports
relation_types.semantics: The source anchors, feeds or stabilizes the target's later growth.

relation_types.label: differentiates into
relation_types.semantics: The source branches or develops into the target output.

relation_types.label: returns as
relation_types.semantics: An output compresses or transfers capability into a form able to begin another cycle.

relation_types.label: germinates toward
relation_types.semantics: Stored generative capacity begins a trajectory toward support and growth.

relation_types.label: complements
relation_types.semantics: The nodes perform distinct but mutually clarifying operations without being synonyms or opposites.

relation_types.label: orders
relation_types.semantics: The source arranges repeated instances of the target into a traversable sequence.

relation_types.label: trajectory through
relation_types.semantics: The source describes recurring movement through or around the target structure.

relation_types.label: preserves passage
relation_types.semantics: The source regime sustains viable selective circulation through the target.

relation_types.label: constrains passage
relation_types.semantics: The source regime can raise exit cost, capture flow or block viable passage through the target.

relation_types.label: counter-regime
relation_types.semantics: The nodes describe contrasting system conditions without assigning moral identity to geometry, people or place.

relation_types.label: expresses through
relation_types.semantics: The source whole becomes legible through a differentiated role without being reducible to that role.

relation_types.label: oriented toward
relation_types.semantics: A theological/functional role is structurally aligned with a field or direction without being identical to the whole field.

relation_types.label: specializes as
relation_types.semantics: A broader role takes on a more specific operator/interface function in the mature model.

relation_types.label: source continuity
relation_types.semantics: Source/support continuity persists across changing states.

relation_types.label: has motif
relation_types.semantics: A role carries a named motif without being identical to it.

relation_types.label: locates
relation_types.semantics: The source locates or anchors the target relation.

relation_types.label: generates next
relation_types.semantics: The source current state can generate the next transferable state/capacity.

relation_types.label: specializes through
relation_types.semantics: The source is expressed through a more specific route/operator.

relation_types.label: unfolds as
relation_types.semantics: The source ordered structure becomes legible as the target temporal/spatial pattern.

relation_types.label: carries through
relation_types.semantics: The source preserves continuity through successive states.

relation_types.label: related through spirit
relation_types.semantics: The relation is mediated by Spirit/flow without identity collapse.

relation_types.label: contains projection of
relation_types.semantics: A visual projection includes a rendered aspect of the target.

relation_types.label: contains lateral line in
relation_types.semantics: A projection includes a lateral line lying in the target section/frame.

relation_types.label: intersects
relation_types.semantics: A trajectory/event intersects the target section or region.

relation_types.label: may satisfy
relation_types.semantics: The source event may satisfy the target's transition conditions.

relation_types.label: sampled on
relation_types.semantics: The source trajectory/dynamics is sampled on the target section.

relations.description: Son/manifestation and Door/transition are distinct but mutually clarifying: Door governs passage; Son embodies the changed state and consequence.
Son is manifestation-facing and aligned with Manifestation Field without being identical with the entire field.
Father is source-facing and aligned with Source Field without being identical with the entire field.
The triune whole remains living and relational through Spirit as continuity, breath and circulation.
The triune whole manifests and passes through Son without reducing the whole to manifestation alone.
The triune whole is source-facing through Father without reducing the whole to Father alone.
The two complete fields interpenetrate without collapsing into one another.
Door contains the portion of the source-facing field shared with manifestation.
Door contains the portion of the manifestation-facing field shared with source.
Plane cuts the shared Door at its widest world-facing middle.
Axis supplies vertical orientation through the source-facing field.
Axis supplies vertical orientation through the manifestation-facing field.
Cross depends on the active horizontal Plane.
Cross depends on the vertical Axis.
Cross is the relational midpoint event inside Door, not a third container.
Face provides presentation/encounter; Eye supplies reception and discernment.
Eye receives what Face presents, creating a recognition relation.
Spirit/Breath/Flow models movement through shared relation and transition.
Flow gains continuity/orientation along the Axis without becoming identical to it.
A potato eye is literally a bud/generative site on the tuber and symbolically functions as aperture/potential.
Root anchors and feeds later differentiated growth.
Tree expresses integrated support as differentiated output/fruit.
Fruit can carry or hand forward compressed generative capacity as seed.
Seed begins a new cycle by developing support before visible mature growth.
Tree differentiates one/few into many; Mountain integrates many toward fewer without making either superior.
Ladder is an ordered sequence of meaningful Doors/thresholds.
Spiral adds recurrent directional displacement to ordered threshold traversal.
Garden conditions keep selective passage, repair and future growth viable.
Shell/Cube becomes capture when containment blocks or monopolizes viable passage.
The contrast is functional circulation/autonomy versus capture, not round-good versus square-bad.
Garden models viable generativity; Swamp models unresolved entanglement and feedback without healthy exit.
Twin supports can stabilize and frame a Door without becoming the Door itself.
Eye evaluates/perceives while Mountain integrates/compresses; summit and discernment are deliberately not identical.
C_F is the typed upper center of the source-facing field rather than a third field.
C_F supplies source orientation while O/Cross supplies relation; neither center replaces the other.
O/Cross supplies shared passage while C_S supplies embodied manifestation, witness and Seed-facing transition.
C_S is the typed lower center of the manifestation-facing field rather than a separate realm.
Father/source language is oriented toward C_F without making the role, coordinate and person-anchor interchangeable.
The manifestation-facing Son role is oriented toward C_S/Twin-Vessel while remaining distinct from O/Jesus-Door.
Father specializes in project grammar as source-facing Mind/orientation/integration without reducing mind to a person or brain region.
Father and Root share source/provenance/generative continuity; conceptual source is distinct from literal lower spatial root position.
Son specializes as embodied manifestation, lived event and consequence.
Lion is a Son-side strength/royal-return motif, not the whole Son.
Door is the operative present where past/provenance and possible future meet current embodied state.
O/Cross gives the geometric location for the Here/Now relational midpoint.
In project grammar every new actionable Seed is initiated from a current present state.
Ladder expresses ordered traversable continuity; Spirit is the living relation/flow through such state transitions.
Spiral is Ladder/history unfolded through recurrence with changed state or level.
Spirit/time continuity carries relation through successive presents rather than existing as a third static location.
Mind/source orientation and Body/manifestation remain dynamically related through Spirit and Door.
Cross-sign includes a visualized segment of the Axis.
Cross-sign includes one chosen lateral line lying in the active Plane.
Crossing event is registered when trajectory intersects the active Plane.
A Plane crossing becomes a strong Door transition only when declared transition guards/state changes are satisfied.
Repeated Plane crossings can be compared to determine recurrence with or without meaningful state change.

canonical_traversals.label: Triune Potato of Life
canonical_traversals.purpose: Read Father, Son and Spirit as irreducible relational expressions of one Potato of Life rather than as three independent systems or as three interchangeable labels.
canonical_traversals.reader_question: How does one living whole preserve source, manifested passage and relational flow without reducing any of them to the others?

canonical_traversals.label: Growth & Return
canonical_traversals.purpose: Show generativity as a cycle: stored possibility develops support, differentiates into visible output, and returns transferable capacity forward.
canonical_traversals.reader_question: What has to be preserved so the output can become future capacity rather than terminal consumption?

canonical_traversals.label: Recognition
canonical_traversals.purpose: Show recognition as a two-sided relation between presentation and perception rather than a property owned by one side alone.
canonical_traversals.reader_question: What is being presented, what is actually perceived, and where can those two diverge?

canonical_traversals.label: Shared Door
canonical_traversals.purpose: Show Door as the genuine shared region between two complete fields, not a third object inserted between them.
canonical_traversals.reader_question: What can be shared without collapsing the distinction between source and manifestation?

canonical_traversals.label: Orientation at the Cross
canonical_traversals.purpose: Show Cross as a derived orientation event inside Door where world-facing Plane and vertical Axis become simultaneously legible.
canonical_traversals.reader_question: Which frame is active, what orientation cuts through it, and what changes when both coordinates are visible?

canonical_traversals.label: Boundary Regime Test
canonical_traversals.purpose: Test boundaries by function: whether they preserve viable passage, repair and autonomy or produce capture, opacity and unresolved entanglement.
canonical_traversals.reader_question: Does this boundary help differentiated life circulate and grow, or make exit and repair progressively harder?

canonical_traversals.label: Three Typed Centers
canonical_traversals.purpose: Read C_F, O/Cross and C_S as three differentiated centers along one relation: source/holding, shared Door, and embodied manifestation/Seed.
canonical_traversals.reader_question: Which function belongs to the source center, which to the shared Door, and which to the manifestation center—and are figure comparisons being kept distinct from literal identity?

canonical_traversals.label: Root → Mind → Here/Now → Body → Spirit/Ladder → Spiral → Fruit → Seed
canonical_traversals.purpose: Read the center as a living time-bearing cycle rather than static titles.
canonical_traversals.reader_question: What came from the past, what is integrated now, what manifests in the body/world, what changes through time, and what becomes the next Seed?

formal_typing_rule: formal_type annotations clarify mathematical/project role; they do not alter canonical ownership, evidence class or imply physical identity.
